event: Check whether the testbench scans logs or has a fail-on-SVA mechanism.

I submitted the verdict as verified: the finding stands.

The assertion `mci_error_non_fatal_cold_rst_check` in `src/integration/asserts/caliptra_ss_top_sva.sv` (lines 236–239) only has a `$display` in its else branch. It prints "SVA ERROR: MCI HW ERROR NON FATAL is expected to reset on cold reset" but does not call `$error` or `$fatal`, so a violation would not fail the test.

I found no `.sv` or non-`.sv` file that scans logs for "SVA ERROR". The same print-only pattern is used by the other SVA assertions I saw in the repo. A `HW_ERROR_NON_FATAL` value that survives a cold reset would go unnoticed unless someone reads the log.

I did not modify any files.
